actual: Repeated maximum-downtime triggers and RTO ≤ MTD mnemonic can obscure the distinction between a system restoration target and business disruption tolerance.
expected: Teach RTO as a recovery target and MTD as the business tolerance; allow for business reprocessing after technical restoration.
evidence: NIST SP 800-34r1 §3.2.1 states RTO normally needs to be shorter than MTD to leave time for reprocessing. Scenario 2 still correctly identifies RTO.
recommendation: Use เป้าหมายระยะเวลาที่ต้องกู้คืนระบบหรือบริการให้พร้อมใช้งาน; explain why the inequality alone does not demonstrate a viable recovery plan.

excerpt: ก่อนจะเกิดความเสียหายที่ไม่อาจฟื้นคืนได้
actual: MTD is described as the threshold before irreversible damage; line 167 further predicts organizational collapse.
expected: MTD concerns the threshold for significant mission/business harm, without requiring irreversible damage or certain collapse.
evidence: Markdown 164 and 167 contain categorical irreversible-damage/collapse wording.
NIST MTD glossary defines disruption tolerance in terms of significant mission harm.
recommendation: Use ก่อนเกิดผลกระทบเกินระดับที่องค์กรยอมรับได้ and describe target-breach consequences without predicting certain collapse.

excerpt: Passphrase ที่มีความยาว ≥ 14 ตัวอักษร
actual: The modern password recommendation gives an unqualified 14-character baseline.
expected: Identify the standard and context: current NIST specifies 15 for single-factor passwords and permits at least 8 when only used within MFA.
evidence: Markdown 327 recommends ≥14 without the authentication context.
Directly checked NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2. A 14-character organizational policy is not universally invalid.
recommendation: Refresh the cited modern baseline and distinguish single-factor from MFA usage; do not present a context-specific minimum as universal.

actual: The memory aid restricts metrics to raw quantitative values and visually puts KPI/KRI on a separate stage.
expected: Metrics can include calculated rates, ratios and averages; KPI/KRI are types of metrics.
evidence: Markdown 441 conflicts with the broader definition at 357.
Generator 1704, 1789–1792 and 1864–1869 repeat the raw-value hierarchy in desktop/mobile variants.
Final NIST SP 800-55v1 §2.4 explicitly includes KPI/KRI as metrics.
recommendation: Show data/measurements feeding metrics including KPI/KRI, followed by communication formats; label the architecture a local teaching aid.

excerpt: ตามบริบทในสไลด์และเนื้อหาการสอบ ISC2 CC
actual: The heading combines Respond/Remediate while the body defines response initiation and asserts an ISC2 exam convention without traceable official evidence.
expected: State the selected expansion and precise start/end events without claiming a universal ISC2 answer convention.
evidence: Markdown 374–376 acknowledges multiple expansions but favors an initiation-only interpretation as exam-specific.
Official public outline does not prescribe an MTTR expansion.
Microsoft primary operational documentation separates acknowledgement from remediation with different timestamps.
recommendation: Add an interval example and defined endpoints; retain the fact that Mean Time to Respond is a valid context-dependent expansion.

excerpt: DISASTER RECOVERY (DR) — แผนกู้คืนระบบเทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศ
actual: Desktop and mobile BC/DR diagram labels translate DR as a plan.
expected: Translate DR as การกู้คืน and reserve แผนการกู้คืน for DRP.
evidence: Generator 1542 and 1577 use แผน for DR.
Markdown 508–513 explicitly distinguishes DR capability/process from DRP document.
NIST SP 800-34r1 distinguishes recovery planning documents and functions.
recommendation: Correct both desktop and mobile Thai labels while preserving the introductory BC/DR scope relationship.

excerpt: การส่งข้อความหลอกลวงทั่วไปแบบไม่เจาะจงเป้าหมายในวงกว้าง
actual: Phishing is restricted to broad non-targeted messages, and a JS scenario contrasts whaling with spear phishing as though categories exclude one another.
expected: Phishing is the broader family, spear phishing is targeted phishing, and whaling targets senior/high-profile recipients within spear phishing.
evidence: Markdown 308–310 and 564–583; scenario JS 70.
Canadian Centre for Cyber Security directly confirms whaling as spear phishing against senior/high-profile targets.
CISA search-indexed text corroborates phishing types, but direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403. Finding does not depend on that blocked retrieval.
recommendation: Label the non-targeted column bulk/generic phishing and explicitly show nesting; retain whaling as scenario 7's most-specific correct answer.

excerpt: ลักษณะของเมทริกซ์ความปลอดภัย
actual: เมทริกซ์ is repeatedly used for metric, creating a matrix-versus-metric semantic collision.
expected: Use ตัวชี้วัด consistently, or a clearly identified metric transliteration.
evidence: Markdown 359, 402, 731–734 and 764; scenario JS 75–78 and 102.
English metric meaning is established internally at Markdown 357 and externally in NIST SP 800-55v1.
Thai spelling judgment is editorial semantic review; no exclusive official Thai glossary spelling was established.
recommendation: Replace เมทริกซ์ when the intended concept is metric; preserve actual matrix terminology where a table/matrix is intended.

excerpt: ผู้โจมตีอาจนำ AI และเทคโนโลยี Deepfake Voice มาช่วยสร้างเรื่องราวหลอกลวง

Official ISC2 live outline page Domain 2 AI integration text was directly retrieved; numbered September 2026 PDF has broader objective bullets.
recommendation: Add compact sourced AI continuity, KRI and playbook examples and a source date; frame as supplemental guidance.

excerpt: การตรวจทานเอกสาร (Checklist / Tabletop Exercise)

expected: Describe document review separately from discussion-based tabletop role/decision practice.

NIST SP 800-84 directly describes facilitator-led scenario discussion without deployment of equipment.

excerpt: ข้อมูลที่ซิงโครไนซ์แบบเกือบ Real-time พร้อมใช้งานทันที
actual: Hot-site synchronization/readiness and recovery windows are stated without clear example qualifiers.

evidence: Markdown 233–242 supplies readiness claims and specific site recovery ranges.
NIST SP 800-34r1 §§3.4.3 and 5.1.5 discusses variation in alternate-site implementation.
recommendation: Add โดยทั่วไป/ตัวอย่าง and explain that design, dependencies and tests establish actual achievable recovery; retain relative readiness/cost ordering.

excerpt: รหัสผ่านที่จัดเก็บด้วยการเข้ารหัสและการแฮชร่วมกับ Salt
actual: Verifier storage wording mixes encryption with salted hashing; line 333 also phrases phishing resistance as an unlimited inability to intercept authentication.
expected: Name salted password hashing with an appropriate cost factor for verifiers; scope encryption and phishing resistance to the intended protections.
evidence: Markdown 328 wording is ambiguous, not evidence that reversible encryption alone is advocated.
Markdown 333 contains ไม่สามารถถูกดักขโมย wording.
NIST SP 800-63B-4 §§3.1.1.2 and 3.2.5 were directly checked.
recommendation: Clarify hashing for verifier storage, transport/additional encryption if intended, and scope phishing-resistant claims without implying immunity to endpoint/session compromise.
